blurb: Guests purchase wine kits and use the facility to make their own wine for personal consumption. The process involves adding water to concentrated grape juice kits and fermenting the wine on site. Labels and shrink caps are included with the kit price, but bottles are not included and can be brought by guests or purchased separately.
extraNote: No samples available for tasting; facility is not a winery · Recommended to notify at least one week ahead for bottling appointment to ensure kit availability
